environment.applyNote: Room files are kept. A room that is working waits until its current work finishes before the configuration is applied.
environment.howItWorks: Cloud and Hosted Machine are configured the same way; Hosted Sandbox isn't open yet. The machine must support the commands in the scripts. The setup script runs in the room directory, the startup script in the task working directory. Both use Bash, 30 minutes each at most, with the machine's current privileges. Environment variables are passed to both scripts and to the AI process; an export in a script isn't carried to the next step. Tools can be installed into $HOME/.local/bin.
environment.howItWorksHome: The setup script's $HOME is the tools directory this project shares on the machine, so tools are installed once and later rooms use them directly. The startup script and the AI process get the room's own $HOME, so don't write anything room-specific from the setup script.
environment.intro: Install tools for rooms, and project dependencies while task code is being prepared. Work rooms share this configuration; the Overview uses the base environment and helps with environment failures.
environment.logNote: The log shows the last 32 KB; older logs are kept in the room's HOME
environment.recoveryNeedsHelp: Automatic recovery couldn't restore the environment; see the Overview for what's needed
environment.recoveryRequested: Handed to the Cheese in the Overview to check; see the Overview for progress
environment.recoveryRetrying: The Cheese in the Overview fixed the environment configuration and is restarting
environment.saveHint: Saving only affects new rooms; existing rooms keep their current configuration
environment.savedNotice: Saved. New rooms use this configuration; existing rooms keep their current version.
environment.scheduledNotice: Scheduled to prepare the environment at the next start; the room's files are kept.
environment.setupHint: Installs tools such as Python and Node. Runs once per project on a machine, and again when a new configuration is applied
environment.startupHint: Runs after a task working directory is created or reopened, installing the dependencies for that task's branch
environment.title: Runtime environment
environment.variableNameInvalid: Variable names can't be empty or repeated
environment.variablesHint: These values are visible to project members and Cheese. Don't store passwords or API keys here.
